level.CONFIRM: observed mean log eps_final inside ci_log_eps for that k

decision_criteria.overall: Arm H is UPSIDE, not foundation: with Arm G confirmed the pre-registration record is 1/1; this arm makes it 2/2 or an honestly reported miss. The paper's claims stand regardless of this forecast's outcome.

structural.ATTENUATE: beta in [0.20, 0.35) (LSTM-like deformation) with H monotone in log(T/k)
structural.CONFIRM: per-arm fitted slope beta in [0.35, 0.65] AND both k-point H within confirm_band
structural.FAIL: beta < 0.20 or non-monotone H or H outside 2x the confirm_band
